invariants.meaning: The original objective, contribution or incident narrative is persisted before any AI call.
AI output is labelled and stored as plan, extraction, suggestion or draft, never as a human decision.
A suggested value becomes operational data only after a named human confirms or corrects it.
Every source observation retains origin, time, identifier, URL, model trace and prior observations.
Each context exposes one primary next action and keeps secondary evidence actions visually subordinate.
Initial entry asks only for information needed to preserve the event or define the monitoring objective.
Each adaptive question states why it appears and how the answer will be used as evidence.
AI failure preserves raw input, names the degraded state and exposes a bounded retry.
Incident wording is saved as digest-backed versions before submission.
Source verification, rejection, monitoring suspension and incident closure require a human reason.
Users receive only their private material and no provider endpoint, prompts or unrelated audit events.
Every state-changing operation emits actor, revision, input/result digests and hash-chain receipt.
Exported evidence connects subject, related runs/observations/versions, events, manifest hashes and limitations.
Command replay is idempotent and stale edits fail rather than silently overwrite.
Missing, unavailable, failed, candidate and verified remain distinct states.
Every successful AI call records purpose, model, redacted endpoint and prompt/input/output digests.
State and integrity survive restart and interrupted journeys resume from the persisted next action.
Keyboard, reduced motion, readable labels and protected evidence download are part of the runtime journey.
